description: It is an advanced open-source deferred rendering sample for the Defold engine, featuring a G-buffer pipeline (albedo, normals, roughness, depth) and a BRDF/PBR-style lighting pass. It includes tiled light culling, cubemap shadow mapping with soft shadows, and volumetric lighting for atmospheric light rays. The demo also showcases post-processing like fisheye or chromatic aberration.
name: BRDF Deferred Rendering Example
